name: Unholy Skill

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Whether because of a lack of talent or a desire for fame, you've bargained for infernal aid. When you gain this contract, choose a skill. You gain a +2 item bonus to checks with that skill. Once per week, at any distance, the devil who holds your bargained contract can cite a royalties clause, taking from you the amount of currency you'd gain from Earning Income on an expert-rank task of your level. The currency teleports directly from your possessions to the devil's vaults. If you're unable to pay, the devil instead takes the item with a value higher than, but closest to, the amount you owe from your possessions as collateral, returning it when you pay the required amount.

Activate—Devil's Work 1 (concentrate, magical, manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

---
Effect You call upon your contract's apprenticeship clause. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your next skill action, and it gains the unholy trait.

Effect: Devil's Work
